1946, March 7
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y. Mar. 7, 1946
God bless you Mrs. John Beaman
A thousand thanks for your good wishes and your favor just noted. We'll pray for you and hope thing go better with your husband, John and will all.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Sincerely yours in Christ Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. 1946, December 3
On a Seraphic Mass Association Card Fr. Solanus wrote the fol- lowing:
Mr. & Mrs. John Beaman for God's holy guidance Dec. 3rd, 1946
God bless you Mrs. Beaman. Nothing more practical to please the Lord than prayers and enrollment for the helpless in Purgatory.
Fr. Solanus
1951, June 6
The following is a typed message on a card written perhaps by his secretary.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA June 6, 1951
Dear Friend,
Thank you for your letter and the donation for the enroll- ment. I sent a certificate to Wilfred. May God bless you, We will remember you in our prayers. Gratefully yours in the Sacred Heart
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
